_comment: Near miss 3: believe the boot log at face value and go provisioning. The most expensive wrong answer, because it spends money to hide the bug.
evidence: The boot log says openrouter=false and groq=false, so those two providers are simply not configured on this host.
why_it_was_missed: Nothing failed loudly; the boot log reports a provider as not configured, so a missing env var reads as provisioning rather than naming.

fix.one_place: provision the OpenRouter and Groq keys again on the host

does_not_fix: Nothing; a fresh key fixes today and the same two providers go quiet again at the next deploy.
